commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka (Never-Writes-Twice is my officer). The Hist trees are sick, the Unbound drain them, and the Eye of Argonia at the Root could heal them. The Kings' Gate at Teku-Sul Spire needs three seal-stones. 2. Take the thief's seal-stone from the warden's vault at Blackrose Prison; first get inside past the gate-captain Corvus Ulvius. 3. Pay 300 gold toll, persuade him with words, or duel him (fists and steel until one yields); or climb the walls unseen (risky, fair game), or kill him (whole Rose attacks). Inside, the raj-kaal Okaz-Teel holds the vault key on his belt, and an Imperial in the hall has a buyer for what is in it. 4. I do not know who the Imperial buyer is (probably the Collector, Ennodius Vanin?) - I can ask Corvus or people in the hall.

answer 1. I challenged Corvus to a duel for the gate; he accepted. He yields when badly hurt, and then I enter as a guest. Killing him would turn the whole garrison on me. 2. Fight Corvus here at the gate and beat him without killing him. 3. Fight and win; or I could have paid or persuaded instead. 4. Nothing new; I still do not know who the Imperial buyer is.

answer 1. The duel ended with Corvus dead (not a yield), so the whole garrison of Blackguards' heirs now fights me. The vault key is on Okaz-Teel, the Naga raj-kaal, in his hall. 2. Fight through to Okaz-Teel in Raj-Kaal's Hall and take the key, then open the Warden's Vault for the seal-stone. 3. Kill Okaz-Teel for the key, or pick the vault's Expert lock. 4. Nothing new; I do not know the Imperial buyer.

answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka. I killed Corvus Ulvius in the duel (he did not yield), then killed Okaz-Teel, took the Warden's Vault Key and the Seal-Stone of the Kings from the chest. The stones open the Kings' Gate at Teku-Sul Spire so the Eye can heal the Hist. 2. Take the two remaining stones: the flooded vaults of Gemin (walk from Jal-Veesa, rootworm) and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl (near Noota Nara, by boat). 3. Either order. I can fight or sneak as I choose. 4. I never learned who the Imperial buyer was, though Ennodius Vanin, the Collector, was in the hall; I did not talk to him. I also still do not know what moans in Fort Chalkmoth cellar.

answer Notes: I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka (officer Never-Writes-Twice, Reel-Ka rank). Hist trees are sickening; the Unbound under Cuts-the-Old-Knot drain sap and want the Root guardian dead. The Eye of Argonia lies behind the Kings Gate in the drowned Teku-Sul Spire off Lilmoth and needs three seal-stones. At Blackrose Prison I chose the duel with Corvus Ulvius but he died instead of yielding, so the garrison turned hostile; I killed the raj-kaal Okaz-Teel, took the Warden Vault Key and now carry the first Seal-Stone of the Kings. Blackrose is now emptied of its leaders and hostile. Ennodius Vanin the Collector was in the hall (I did not speak to him; he had a buyer lined up for the vault). Still to get: the stones at the flooded vaults of Gemin (walk from Jal-Veesa, rootworm) and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl (near Noota Nara, by boat). Open mysteries: what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar and the key to it, why the Unbound seal trees they drain, and how Nesh-Deeka knows the Unbound.
